why: The authors' repository exists and the clone itself succeeded — only the working-tree checkout failed, because it contains a file whose name embeds '|' (illegal on NTFS/Windows). The git objects are therefore intact and the sources can be restored with a --no-checkout clone plus a path-restricted checkout of the .py/.ipynb/.csv files. The match target (C1) is a plain scikit-learn RBF-SVM + StandardScaler + GridSearchCV pipeline on Breast Cancer Wisconsin, which is shippable as sklearn.datasets.load_breast_cancer (569x30) — no external download, no weights, no GPU, and every dependency (scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, scipy) is pip-installable on Python 3.12. So the authors' logic should run essentially as released after one small environment fix (the filename/checkout workaround) rather than needing a rebuild.
